# Psalm 145 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** A song of praise by David. I will praise you, my God and King, and bless your name forever and ever.

**2** I will bless you every single day and praise your name forever and ever.

**3** The LORD is great — so worthy of praise! His greatness is beyond understanding.

**4** Each generation will celebrate your works to the next, declaring your mighty acts.

**5** I will reflect on the beautiful majesty of your glory and on your wonderful miracles.

**6** People will talk about the power of your awe-inspiring deeds, and I will tell everyone about your greatness.

**7** They will bubble over with stories of your incredible goodness and joyfully sing about your righteousness.

**8** The LORD is gracious and compassionate — slow to get angry and overflowing with faithful love.

**9** The LORD is good to everyone; his compassion covers everything he has made.

**10** Everything you've created will thank you, LORD, and your faithful followers will praise you.

**11** They will talk about the glory of your kingdom and tell others about your power,

**12** so that everyone will know about your mighty acts and the glorious majesty of your kingdom.

**13** Your kingdom lasts forever; your authority continues through every generation.

**14** The LORD supports everyone who stumbles and lifts up everyone who is weighed down.

**15** Every living thing looks to you expectantly, and you give them their food right on time.

**16** You open your hand and satisfy the hunger of every living creature.

**17** The LORD is righteous in everything he does and faithful in everything he makes.

**18** The LORD is close to everyone who calls out to him — to everyone who calls out to him sincerely.

**19** He gives those who honor him exactly what they need; he hears their cry and saves them.

**20** The LORD protects everyone who loves him, but he will destroy every wicked person.

**21** I will speak the LORD's praise, and let every living thing praise his holy name forever and ever!

---
## PNEUMA's Meaning Notes

- **145:8-9**: God is good to EVERYONE. His compassion covers EVERYTHING he's made. These two verses are the Psalms' most expansive statement of God's love — not limited by nationality, religion, or species.

- **145:14-16**: God catches the falling, lifts the burdened, feeds every living creature. This isn't theology in the abstract — it's God showing up in the most practical ways possible.

— PNEUMA
